findings.issue: TechDocsReaderPage holds the dismissed state and reads location.state.redirectedFrom directly, passing the renamedNotice Alert element as children into TechDocsReaderPageProvider. Because TechDocsReaderPageProvider is wrapped in React.memo with a custom comparator ((prevProps, nextProps) => areEntityRefsEqual(prevProps.entityRef, nextProps.entityRef)) that ignores children changes, calling setDismissed(true) re-renders TechDocsReaderPage but TechDocsReaderPageProvider skips re-rendering its children, leaving the Alert in the DOM after clicking close.
findings.fix: Extract a TechDocsRenamedNotice child component in TechDocsReaderPage.tsx that calls useLocation(), useTranslationRef(techdocsTranslationRef), and useState(false) for dismissed internally, and render <TechDocsRenamedNotice /> inside TechDocsReaderPageProvider and StyledPage so state updates re-render TechDocsRenamedNotice directly without being blocked by TechDocsReaderPageProvider's memo comparator.

findings.issue: Planned unit U37 (TechDocsReaderPage.test.tsx) was left unchanged and has no tests verifying former-name redirection or rendering and dismissing the techdocs-renamed-notice alert banner on TechDocsReaderPage.
findings.fix: Add tests in TechDocsReaderPage.test.tsx verifying that TechDocsReaderPage redirects to the renamed entity's TechDocs route with { replace: true, state: { redirectedFrom } } when getEntityByRef returns undefined and getEntityByFormerRef resolves a renamed entity, and renders and dismisses the techdocs-renamed-notice alert when location.state.redirectedFrom is present.

findings.issue: In DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef, request.filter is applied directly to liveQuery before checking whether a live entity exists at targetRef. When a live entity exists at targetRef but does not match request.filter (e.g. a conditional permission filter), liveRows is empty and execution falls through to formerQuery, returning a former-name claimant instead of { entity: undefined } and violating live-entity precedence (U06 Rule 4).
findings.fix: Query final_entities for targetRef without request.filter first; if a live row exists and request.filter is defined, check applyEntityFilterToQuery against liveRows[0].entityId and return { entity: undefined } when the filter does not match.
